query: Micron fiscal year end date and fiscal quarter dates
normalized: date dates end fiscal micron quarter year

output.content:
Micron’s fiscal year generally ends in **late August**; in fiscal 2025, it ended **August 28, 2025**. [[1]] 

Using FY2025 as the concrete calendar, Micron’s fiscal quarters were: 

| Fiscal quarter | Period end |
|---|---:|
| **FQ1 2025** | November 28, 2024 |
| **FQ2 2025** | February 27, 2025 |
| **FQ3 2025** | May 29, 2025 |
| **FQ4 2025 / fiscal year-end** | August 28, 2025 |

Micron reported FQ1 ended November 28, 2024, FQ2 ended February 27, 2025, FQ3 ended May 29, 2025, and FQ4/FY2025 ended August 28, 2025. [[2]] [[3]] [[4]] [[1]] 

The exact dates can shift slightly year to year, but the cadence is typically: **late November, late February, late May, and late August**. [[2]] [[4]] [[5]]
